items.title: The Cohen-ring diagram of a local homomorphism of complete Noetherian local rings
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma constructs the standard diagram expressing a local homomorphism of complete Noetherian local rings as a quotient of a map between power series rings over fields or Cohen rings, with surjective horizontal arrows and with the vertical map sending a regular system of parameters to part of a regular system of parameters. The proof chooses the two power series presentations using the Cohen structure theorem, lifts the composition along the formally smooth power series ring by the lifting result for continuous maps, and then performs an explicit change of the target presentation by adjoining new variables shifted by the images of the source variables, which arranges the regular system of parameters condition; the flatness and regular fibre assertions follow from the regularity inputs.
